scope: One rehearsal in the room built from the Muse Spark scene spec of the generated living-room image (living_room_pedestal): the user-corrected pedestal (0.30 x 0.28 x 0.90 m, 3 kg) is approached from the door, grasped (IK reach, joints re-anchored to the palms), lifted 10 cm, carried to the requested pose and set down. Checkpoints are null until the room approach/carry runs finish, so both walking phases use the scripted pursuit-and-docking controller; set them to the trained model files to rehearse with the learned policies. Placement error is measured against the requested pose with the carry tolerance (10 cm / 10 degrees).
